snippet.title: Cosmic Crowbar ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER!
snippet.description:
👉WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM!👈
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4339380/Cosmic_Crowbar/

Finally! 
Here you have a glimpse of what a team of great fellows and myself have been working for awhile. 
Under Steven Dengler's vision and the characters he created long ago, we are building this 2D action/story game that we think you are gonna love it. This is the first step into the public. Hope you like it!


Cosmic Crowbar™ is a story-driven action adventure featuring 100% handcrafted art, animation, and music in development by Dracogen Studios. Play as the astounding Cosmic Crowbar, who has crossed the cosmos and crash landed on a freakish, far-flung world called... Earth! Gravely injured, he merges with a common crowbar to survive! Alone and far from home, the plucky prybar explores the endless, enigmatic Rastin Salvage scrapyard, assembling ardent allies and facing fearsome foes! What mesmerizing mysteries and strange secrets lie in store? What astonishing adventures await our mighty metallic hero?
